findings.body: The previous P2 remains unresolved. Both machine views read events.jsonl without the writer guard (src/forge/board.py:203–204). On Windows, an open reader can make this replacement raise PermissionError, interrupting a worker, reader, reviewer or test run while it reports progress. The guard serializes writers only. Apply bounded reader-lock retries, as the existing replacement helper does in src/forge/codex.py:534–543.
findings.title: Handle Windows readers holding the progress file open
